Commentary.Commentary: Zimbabwe will be looking to be watchful and see off the new ball. Innocent Kaia has done well in the shorter versions of the game and let's see how his opening partner Tanunurwa Makoni does on his Test debut.
... SECOND INNINGS...

It's a very competitive total in the first innings from the touring team. The record opening stand between Kraigg Brathwaite and Tagenarine Chanderpaul set the tone and then West Indies decided to go for quick runs. They kept on losing wickets at regular intervals but still, the Windies' batters stuck to the plan. The pitch was looking as flat as a pancake in the early half but it has certainly started to offer a good amount of help to the bowlers, especially the spinners. Brandon Mavuta made full use of it and claimed a fifer and he was the only bowler to take some solace from an otherwise disappointing and tough outing on the field. Let's see how their batters fare against a quality bowling attack of West Indies. Stay tuned...

This was on the cards once Tagenarine Chanderpaul completed his marathon knock. He is walking back with his bat raised and is getting applauded by the Zimbabwean players as well. It's been a great inning of application and patience from the young man.
Floated up full and on leg stump, Joshua Da Silva heaves it toward deep mid-wicket for a single. And, the declaration has also come! West Indies end their first innings with 447/6 on the board.
Flighted delivery on leg stump, Chanderpaul punches it from his crease and down to long on for one.
Shorter this time and around off, this is played off the back foot to sweeper cover for one.
Flatter delivery around off, Joshua Da Silva shuffles across the stumps and tries to pull it toward fine leg but misses.
This is on the pads, Chanderpaul works it through square leg for a single.

SIX! BANG! Take a bow, Tagenarine Chanderpaul! Chanderpaul comes down the pitch and gets to the pitch of the ball before smoking it right back over the bowler's head to bring up his maiden double ton in style. Chanderpaul punches the air in delight and soaks in the applause as well. He now becomes the 10th West Indian to convert his maiden hundred into a double and he is certainly keeping the family name flying high.
Flatter delivery around middle and staying a touch low, Da Silva keeps it out.

Flighted once again around middle and leg, Chanderpaul looks to flick but gets beaten in the flight a bit. The ball comes off the inner half of the bat and rolls toward fine leg. They get a single and Chanderpaul moves to 199.
Flighted delivery around off, Chanderpaul defends it off the front foot.
Shorter and sitting up for the batter around off. Joshua Da Silva hits it off the back foot to deep cover for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Joshua Da Silva gets a big stride in and blocks it out.

Drinks break. The highlight of the session has to be the 5-wicket haul for Brandon Mavuta. The leg spinner toiled hard and has been rewarded eventually. He has got some support from the surface and the attacking approach of the West Indian batters also assisted his cause. The tourists have lost wickets at regular wickets in their bid to score quick runs. It seems that they want to declare before the Tea break. Anyway, all eyes will be now on Tagenarine Chanderpaul who is two away from a double century. Joshua Da Silva has joined him in the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Another peach of a delivery from Brandon Mavuta and he picks up a five-wicket haul! Mavuta gives it considerably more air and flights it on a shortish length outside the off stump. Jason Holder gets drawn into the shot and gets beaten in the flight. The ball turns away a touch and takes the outside edge of Holder's blade and Tafadzwa Tsiga pouches it safely behind the stumps. Holder doesn't even wait for the umpire's finger to be raised and walks back. Mavuta is absolutely delighted and rightly so.
Commentary.Howout: c Tafadzwa Tsiga b Brandon Mavuta

Commentary.Commentary: Maiden over from Wellington Masakadza and Tagenarine Chanderpaul stays stranded on 198. This is floated up on off, Chanderpaul soldily blocks it out.
Nicely flighted at the stumps, Chanderpaul comes down the pitch and ends up just blocking it out.
Very full and around middle, Chanderpaul pushes it off the front foot but straight to mid on.
Shortens the length and bowls it on middle and leg, Chanderpaul wrists it onto the on side.
A bit fuller and on off stump, Chanderpaul stays watchful and keeps it out.
This is flighted on a nagging length around middle, Tagenarine Chanderpaul blocks it out.
Nicely tossed up, full and on off, Jason presses forward and defends it to covers.
Quicker and shorter on off, Holder goes on the back foot and blocks it to the off side.
Play and a miss! Loopy and full, way wide outside off, Holder throws his bat at it but fails to connect.
Quicker one, short and on middle, Chanderpaul goes back to punch but his bottom hand comes off the handle. Still, he places it wide of mid-wicket and it travels to long on. A single to move to 198.
Fuller and on off, Chanderpaul leans forward and wrists it to mid-wicket.
Slower through the air, dropping full and around off, Chanderpaul defends.
Flatter and shorter, on off, Holder defends it back from the crease.
Full again, outside off, this time it's driven through mid off for a single.
Serves it full and around off, Chanderpaul defends it off the front foot.
Full and around off, Chanderpaul gets forward and flicks it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Fullish and around off, Holder goes down and across before paddling it wide of short fine leg. Takes a single.
Turning in from around middle, Chanderpaul flicks to the left of mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Short again, on off, Chanderpaul goes on the back foot again and punches it down to long off for one.
Drags his length short and delivers it close to off, Tagenarine camps back and cuts it through cover-point for a couple.
Flighted delivery, full and outside off, Holder strides forward and drives it to sweeper cover for a run.
Short again, close to off, Holder cuts but finds the fielder at cover-point.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Holder covers his stumps and shoulders arms.
Flighted delivery, landing full on middle, Chanderpaul knocks it down to long on for a single. Moves to 192.
Loopy and full, drifting in around middle, Holder again presents a straight bat after getting forward.
Fuller and on off, Holder prods forward and defends it down.
Turning in from a shorter length around off, Chanderpaul goes back and helps it in the gap at mid-wicket for a single.
Around off, punched to covers.
Presses forward to a full ball and nudges it towards mid on. The fielder makes a sliding stop.
Floated delivery, full and on off, Chanderpaul gets on the front foot and defends it back.
Flatter leg spinner around off, Jason goes on the back foot and defends it down to point.
Leans forward to a full ball and drives. But Holder picks out the fielder at extra cover.
SIX! Effortless from the tall man! Loopy and full, around off, Holder goes down and dispatches it over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Flatter one, on middle and a bit on the shorter side, Holder moves back and turns it to mid-wicket.
Full and around off, Chanderpaul drives it down to long off for one.
Serves it full and way wide outside off, Holder reaches out and strokes it to sweeper cover for one.
The length is slightly short, around off, Holder goes back and eases it down to long off for a run.
Arm ball around off, skidding in, Holder tries to drive but gets an inside edge.
Fuller again, around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Presses forward and defends a full ball on the leg side.
Flatter and shorter around off, Chanderpaul moves back and punches it down to long on for a single.
Full and on off, defended.
Full toss around middle and leg, Chanderpaul forces it down to long on for a run.
Very full and outside off, Holder drives it with the spin to deep cover-point. Gets off the mark with a single.
Floated and on off, Holder defends it off the front foot.
Tossed up outside off, Holder takes a big stride to cover the line and makes a leave.
Jason Holder is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT AT FIRST SLIP! Fourth wicket for Mavuta and things are now happening for Zimbabwe. A lovely delivery, full and floated outside off, there is width and Chase tries for a big booming drive. But to his disappointment, the ball spins away late, at the point of contact and a thick outside edge hurries away to first slip. Craig Ervine is alert and he takes a fantastic reflex catch, stretching away to his right. The wickets continue to tumble and in no time, West Indies have lost half their side.
Commentary.Howout: c Craig Ervine b Brandon Mavuta

Commentary.Commentary: Nice flight but it's too full on off, Chase drives it to short cover.
Nice loop this time, around off, Chanderpaul prods forward and blocks it safely.
Fuller and on off, defended to the off side off the front foot.
Slower through the air, full and on middle, Tagenarine lunges and defends it down.
SIX! Dismissed! Flighted delivery, around off and fuller in length, Tagenarine Chanderpaul jumps down the track and sends it many a mile over long off. Moves to 187.
Even better! Loopy and full around off, Chase lofts it behind the bowler and takes a single. They are looking for quick runs, it seems that the declaration is coming soon.
FOUR! Fine shot! A touch short and on middle, Chase stands tall inside the crease, uses his height to get on top of the bounce and whips it to the right of the mid-on fielder for a boundary.
Shortish again, around off, pushed to covers.
FOUR! Drags his length short around off, Tagenarine Chanderpaul goes on the back foot and smashes it through covers. 400 comes up for West Indies!
Short in length and outside off, Chanderpaul goes back and steers it wide of backward point. He returns for the second run. There is an appeal for a run out at the striker's end but nothing doing.
Floated and drifting around middle, Chanderpaul walks forward and tickles it towards mid-wicket.
Around off, fuller in length, Chase eases it to covers and rotates the strike.
Floated and full, around off, Chase eases it to covers.
Stays back to punch it through the line but not in the gap on the off side.
Around middle and off, defended on the off side.
Flighted on off, defended back to the bowler.
That is punched off the back foot, but not in the gap.
This one is forced through extra cover for a couple.
Loopy and full, around off, defended off the front foot.
A loopy full toss on off stump, this one is dipping on the batter and Chanderpaul presents the full face of the bat to drive it down to long on for a single.
Shorter around middle and leg, tucked away leg side.
Short and wide, Chanderpaul rocks back and slaps it through the cover region for a couple of runs.
Full and around off, this is pushed down to long off for a single. Chase is off the mark!

Huge appeal for lbw now but it is turned down! Brandon Mavuta bowls the googly first up to Roston Chase and this is delivered around off stump. The ball turns in sharply and seems to have beaten the defense of Chase, going on to hit him on the back leg. The umpire turns the appeal down probably because of a faint inside edge.
Roston Chase is in next. Meanwhile, Richard Ngarava is seen heading into the dressing. Hopefully, nothing serious.

OUT! CAUGHT! A bit too aggressive from Jermaine Blackwood and Brandon Mavuta does get the better of him. Mavuta gives it a bit more air and tosses it up on the middle stump line. Blackwood has a big swing across the line and against the turn as well and ends up getting a top edge. The ball lobs up in front of the square leg region. The keeper, Tafadzwa Tsiga, calls it early and settles under it to take an easy catch which is also his very first catch in international cricket. West Indies self-destructing here a bit.
Commentary.Howout: c Tafadzwa Tsiga b Brandon Mavuta

Commentary.Commentary: A bit flatter and on middle, Chanderpaul defends it out.
Wellington Masakadza sees Tagenarine Chanderpaul advancing down the track and gives it a bit more flight. Chanderpaul manages to push it back to the bowler.
A tad short and around off, Chanderpaul stays back and nudges it toward backward point.
Flatter delivery around off, Chanderpaul dabs it down toward backward point.
Holds it back a touch and floats it outside off stump. Jermaine Blackwood gets down on one knee and brooms it away to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Flighted delivery around off stump, Chanderpaul gets on the front foot and just eases it through mid on for a single.
This is bowled full and on off stump, Jermaine Blackwood hits it firmly back to the bowler.
FOUR! Asserting authority right from the get-go! Tossed up on middle and leg, Jermaine Blackwood clears the front leg and slog-sweeps it into the mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Jermaine Blackwood arrives.

OUT! CAUGHT! Straight to the man and Raymon Reifer is livid with himself. This is a real drag down by Brandon Mavuta as he bowls it short and on off. Reifer gets deep in his crease and shuffles across a bit in order to pull. Reifer does so and gets a good connection but fails to find the elevation. The ball goes straight down the throat of the fielder at deep mid-wicket and Innocent Kaia there makes no mistake. Reifer departs cheaply and Mavuta has his second wicket in the game.
Commentary.Howout: c Innocent Kaia b Brandon Mavuta

Commentary.Commentary: Easy singles on offer at the moment for the Windies batters. Tossed up around off, Chanderpaul eases it down to long on for yet another single.
Floated up around off stump, this is firmly pushed down to long on for one more.
Very full and around middle, Chanderpaul drives it gently down to long on and turns the strike over.
Gives it a loop now and delivers it on off stump, Raymon Reifer comes forward and pushes it to the left of the bowler but Wellington Masakadza makes a good stop.
Nicely flighted around off stump and turning in, Reifer blocks it out.
Shortens the length and bowls it on leg stump, Reifer nudges it onto the on side.
Nicely bowled! This is flighted up on a nagging length and angling into off stump. Raymon Reifer looks to block off the back foot but the ball holds its line and beats the outside edge.
Bowls it a bit fuller and on off, Chanderpaul gets on the front foot and punches it down to long on for one.
This is shorter and turning onto the pads, Chanderpaul tucks it straight to mid-wicket.
Flatter one around off, Raymon Reifer nudges it toward backward point and looks for a quick single but is sent back and rightly so.
This is floated up on the stumps, Chanderpaul pushes it down to long on for a single.
Flatter one on off stump, punched away onto the off side.
FOUR! First runs of the session and four of them. Tossed up around middle, Tagenarine Chanderpaul gets down on one knee and slog-sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
A tad shorter and around off, kept out by Chanderpaul.

Was there an edge? This is quicker and shorter, turning in from outside off. Tagenarine Chanderpaul rocks back to cut but seems to have got a faint nick on it. The keeper, Tafadzwa Tsiga spills it though and Mavuta isn't impressed.

We are back for the post-Lunch session on Day 3! The umpires and the players are back out in the middle. It will be Tagenarine Chanderpaul and Raymon Reifer to resume their stay on the crease for West Indies. Brandon Mavuta to get the proceedings underway with the ball here.
... DAY 3, SESSION 2 ...

West Indies are in the driver's seat and expect them to bat with an even better rate in the afternoon session. A score close to 500 could be on their radar and there is a high possibility to see Zimbabwe batting this evening. The way Brandon Mavuta extracted extra bite from the surface to dismiss Kyle Mayers will encourage the West Indian bowlers. Anyway, let's not get ahead of ourselves and go with the flow. Do join us at 4.10 pm IST (10.40 am GMT) for the second session.

A couple of wickets in the second half and at last, Zimbabwe had something to smile about. That said, it was yet another fine session for West Indies and they have extended their advantage in this Test match. Their openers once again stamped their authority and Kraigg Brathwaite, in particular, batted with a lot of intent this morning. He scored runs at a brisk rate and was unfortunate to miss out on a double century. Wellington Masakadza was the bowler to get the first breakthrough but Zimbabwe let a few chances go begging. One such opportunity was against Tagenarine Chanderpaul who was dropped by Chamu Chibhabha at fine leg.
Floated up on middle and leg, Raymon Reifer works it away to wide mid on. A maiden! And, that will be Lunch on Day 3!
Short again on off stump, blocked out.
Keeps the length a bit short and bowls it around off, Reifer keeps it out on the off side.
Shorter and around off, Raymon Reifer gets across the off stump and makes a solid block.
A bit flatter and quicker around off, Reifer dabs it down behind point.
Flighted delivery outside off, Raymon Reifer gets a big stride in and blocks it toward covers.
A tad shorter and around off, Raymon Reifer looks to block with gentle hands but gets an outside edge past first slip and gets off the mark with a single.
Nagging length again outside off and turning in. Raymon Reifer goes deep in his crease to keep this one out.
Shortens the length and bowls it around off, Raymon Reifer keeps it out on the off side.
Drifted onto middle and leg, Raymon Reifer tentatively blocks it out.
Raymon Reifer walks in next, at number 4.

OUT! TIMBER! A ripper of a delivery from Brandon Mavuta and Kyle Mayers' defense is breached! Mavuta flights this one up on a nagging length around the off stump and gets the ball to grip. Mayers looks to plant the front foot forward and push it onto the off side but the ball turns in and beats the inside edge. The ball goes through the gap between the bat and the pad to knock over the top of the leg stump.
Gives it some air and bowls it full on middle, Kyle Mayers blocks it out.
A bit fuller and around off, this is pushed away to the right of the bowler.
Shorter again and on the pads, Kyle Mayers goes deep in his crease and tucks it through square leg for a single.
Slower and shorter around middle and leg, Chanderpaul works it off the back foot and behind square on the leg side for one more.
Nagging length, turning into the legs, Chanderpaul goes back in his crease to keep it out on the leg side.
Fractionally short and angling down leg, Mayers pulls it down to fine leg for one.
Good use of the feet by Chanderpaul. Tossed up around middle, Chanderpaul gets to the pitch of the ball and pushes it down to long on for a run.
SIX! Once again the final delivery of the over goes the distance. This is short and on off stump, Kyle Mayers goes on the back foot and lifts it right back over the wide long off fence for a maximum.
Around middle, nudged away onto the leg side.
Shorter again around middle and turning in a long way. Kyle Mayers goes on the back foot to pull but misses and wears it on his pads.
Quicker and shorter on middle and leg, Chanderpaul forces it off the back foot down to long on for a single.
A bit flatter this time and around middle, Chanderpaul keeps it out.
Flighted delivery outside off, Chanderpaul steps down the track and works it straight to short mid-wicket.

SIX! Stand and deliver! Wellington Masakadza tosses this one up right in the slot around off, Kyle Mayers gets the front leg out of the way and slogs it well over the cow-corner fence for a biggie. West Indies turning on the heat here.
Quicker and flatter around off, Kyle Mayers punches it onto the off side.
Floats this one up full and around off, Chanderpaul gets on the front foot and turns it well in front of mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted delivery around off stump, Chanderpaul keeps it out.
Slower and shorter around the pads, this is nudged onto the leg side.
FOUR! Pulled away! This is short and angling down leg, Chanderpaul gets inside the line of the ball and pulls it fine of the man at short fine leg for a boundary.
Skidding around leg, it's nudged towards square leg for a single.
The batter comes forward and plays the drive to covers.
Flighted and on off, Chanderpaul prods forward and blocks.
Four byes! Loopy and down the leg side, further spinning down, Tagenarine Chanderpaul tries to flick but misses. It goes wide of the keeper and races away to the fence at fine leg.
Floated and full, around off, Chanderpaul flicks but finds mid-wicket.

DROPPED! Brandon Mavuta tosses this one up on a shorter length and on the pads. Tagenarine Chanderpaul looks to sweep it behind square leg but gets a top edge that flies wide of the man at fine leg. Chamu Chibhabha there runs towards the chance but is a bit late to put in the dive and only gets fingertips on it. The batters take two.
FOUR! Fantastic shot! Masakadza is on the shorter side, around off, Mayers goes on the back foot and punches it sweetly through the gap at covers for a boundary.
Eases a full ball through the line, wide of mid off for a single. 150 up for Tagenarine Chanderpaul! The young man is just extending his good form.
Around off, watchfully blocked.
Fuller on off, that is defended solidly off the front foot.
Spinning in from around off, Chanderpaul helps it with the turn to mid-wicket.
Tossed up outside off, punched to covers.
Loopy and on off, defended down on the surface.
Flighted and around off, Mayers helps it to short mid-wicket.
Too full and on off, Mayers digs it out to the cover region.
On middle, helped on the leg side but towards mid-wicket's right. He makes a good stop.
Fuller and off, pushed back to the bowler.
Short in length, around off, Mayers goes back and punches but without much timing to the off side.
Lunges to a full ball around off and jams it down on the surface.
Flighted and outside off, Tagenarine Chanderpaul leans forward and defends it to the off side.
Loopy and full, landing around off, Mayers knocks it down to long on for one.
Quicker and fuller, around off, defended to covers.
Quicker and fuller, around off, defended to covers.
Fullish and on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Floated again, full and around off, Chanderpaul pushes it with gentle hands to covers and looks for a run. It's not on.
Short and outside off, Chanderpaul goes back and cuts but finds point.
Spinning in from around off, Chanderpaul gets back and taps it down to mid-wicket.
Loopy and on off, worked to mid-wicket.
Full and on off, Tagenarine eases it down to mid on.
Slower through the air, full and floated around off, Chanderpaul flicks but finds square leg.
Quicker and on off, defended off the back foot.
Turning down the leg side, it's nudged behind square leg for a run.

Nearly a return catch! Tossed up around off, short and spinning in, Kyle gets back to punch but the ball stops a bit onto him. He ends up chipping it back and the ball goes just wide of the bowler to long on. They cross.
Fullish and around off, pushed down to mid off.
Loopy and full, around middle, Mayers defends it near his pads.
Kyle Mayers walks in at number 3.

OUT! STOP THE PRESS! Zimbabwe have taken a wicket. At last, we realize, it's legal to pick wickets in this Test match. Jokes apart, it's an excellent delivery from Wellington Masakadza. He gets a full ball to drift in around off and it straightens a hint after landing, Kraigg Brathwaite goes down to sweep but misses. He is rapped on the pads, it looks quite adjacent to the stumps and the finger goes up immediately after the appeal. The front foot is checked and it's fine. Kraigg Brathwaite returns after a valiant knock.
Wellington Masakadza (16-6-30-0) to bowl for the first time on Day 3.
Quicker one, flatter and shorter around off, Kraigg moves back and tucks it behind backward square leg for one.
Flatter and around leg, Chanderpaul presents a dead bat to it and the ball takes the inner edge. It dribbles towards short fine leg and they change ends.
Loopy delivery, full and on off, Chanderpaul flicks it through square leg and takes a couple of runs. Easy going for West Indies.
Quicker and fuller on middle, it's worked through mid-wicket for a single.
A low full toss on off, it's knocked down to long on for a run.
Helped through mid-wicket for a single.

Misfield! Fuller and on off, Brathwaite drills it down to mid off and sets off for a run. The fielder tries to attack but misfields and it races away. The mid-on fielder cuts it off near the fence and they take three runs in total.
Bowls it full and on middle, from 'round the wicket, Brathwaite defends it back to the bowler.
Slower one, full and down the leg side, Kraigg tries flicking but misses.
Slower one, on a length around off, Chanderpaul delays his shot and works it in the gap at mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Fullish around off, angling in, Chanderpaul walks across the stumps and strokes it past mid on for a boundary. Tagenarine Chanderpaul is showing his range here.
Width there outside off, the batter punches it down to mid off and rushes to the other end for a single.
Short and close to off, Chanderpaul goes deep inside the crease and cuts. He finds the fielder at covers.
Goes on the back foot and plays a short ball down to point.
A low full toss dipping in around off, Chanderpaul helps it down to mid on where the fielder makes a diving stop.
Very full and on middle, it's pushed back in the direction of the bowler.
FOUR! Thumped! Tossed up around off, too full in length, Tagenarine Chanderpaul leans forward and caresses it through extra cover for a boundary.
Loopy and full, outside off, Chanderpaul goes down to sweep but gets an inside edge and it rolls to short fine leg.
On a good length, around off, Tagenarine Chanderpaul punches it to covers for one.
Clips a full ball in the gap at mid-wicket for a single.
Full again, around off, this time Chanderpaul forces it past mid on. Mavuta chases and dives near the fence to pull it back. Saves three runs with his energetic effort.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it down to mid on.
Full again, around off, Kraigg uses the angle and wrists it in front of square on the leg side for one.
Fuller and on off, driven through covers for a single.
Fuller one on the pads, this is worked away to deep mid-wicket for one.
Floated up on the pads, this is flicked straight to square leg.
FOUR! This is fired in on the legs, Chanderpaul looks to step out and flick but gets an inside edge past the stumps. The ball runs away into the fine-leg fence for a boundary.
Flighted delivery around off, Kraigg Brathwaite leans forward and wrists it 'round the corner for one.
Nicely tossed up, full and on off stump, Chanderpaul knocks it to wide mid on and picks up a single.
Around off stump, kept out by Chanderpaul.
Back of a length around off, this is played off the back foot in front of cover-point for a single.

Full and around off, punched right back to the bowler. Brad Evans collects the ball and shows a bit of aggression by having a go at the batter but his throw is wide and Chanderpaul had already moved out of the way.
A length ball around off, Chanderpaul works it to the left of the man at mid on.
Fullish length outside off, Chanderpaul moves across the off stump and hits it hard toward mid off.
A bit slower and pushed outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite waits for it and plays it on the up to sweeper cover for a single.
Good length around the top of off, this is punched away to mid off.
Maiden! Tossed up on middle and off, Chanderpaul puts a stride forward and makes the block.
Short and around off, this is punched off the back foot but straight to the cover fielder.
Flighted this time around off, Chanderpaul gets on the front foot and pushes it to mid on.
Shorter and down leg, Chanderpaul stays back and dabs it down to leg gully.
Floated up on the stumps, Chanderpaul watchfully blocks it out.
Fuller and around middle, pushed back past the diving bowler to mid on.
Back of a length at the stumps, Kraigg nudges it onto the leg side.

FOUR! Another record has tumbled! This is now the highest-ever opening stand for West Indies in Test cricket, beating the previous best of 298 runs set by Gordon Greenidge and Desmond Haynes in 1990 against England. Coming to the ball, it is short and on the body, Kraigg Brathwaite gets inside the line and works it off his hips into the fine leg fence. The 300 is also up for West Indies.

DROPPED! Brad Evans almost gets the first breakthrough for Zimbabwe. Slower one on a good length and around off. The ball holds up in the deck a bit and Kraigg Brathwaite ends up getting a leading edge. The ball lobs up to the right of the bowler who does well to adjust and dive that side but only manages to get a right hand on it. The ball slips out at the last moment. A valiant effort nonetheless from the debutant.
Full and around off stump, Kraigg Brathwaite jams it out on the off side.
This is full and wide outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite tries to reach it but fails to do so.

FOUR! An agricultural heave this from Kraigg Brathwaite. Pitched up outside off, Kraigg looks to go over mid on but gets it off the inner half of the bat and well wide of the man at mid on for a boundary.

Drinks break! This has been a fruitful morning thus far for West Indies as they have scored 71 runs in just 17 overs. Kraigg Brathwaite has looked aggressive and has hit a flurry of boundaries to up the ante. The Zimbabwe pacers looked unlikely to create any chances and the one chance that was created by spin was spilled by the keeper. The visiting team will look to keep on scoring quickly whereas the home side will be desperate to break this opening stand.
Short and on off stump, Chanderpaul defends it out.
Short and outside off, Tagenarine Chanderpaul waits on the back foot and plays it late past the man at backward point for a couple of runs.
Short and wide, this is punched off the back foot towards sweeper cover for one more.
Short again outside off, Chanderpaul goes on the back foot and plays it with an angled bat toward backward point for a single.
Shorter and around the pads, Chanderpaul works it to square leg.
A bit quicker and around middle, Chanderpaul nudges it to the on-side.
This is banged in well short and around off, Chanderpaul gets on top of the bounce and plays a controlled pull shot down to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball, angling in from outside off, Chanderpaul shuffles across and pushes it to mid on. He looks for the run but quickly decides against it.
Fullish length pushed well outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite reaches out and taps it toward covers for a run.
Back of a length over off stump, Chanderpaul forces it off the back foot toward mid on and picks up a quick single.
Good length outside off, Chanderpaul pushes it towards cover.
A cheeky attempt out of nowhere! This is pitched up well outside off, Chanderpaul shuffles across and attempts the paddle shot but fails to get bat on ball.
Nicely tossed up on the stumps, Chanderpaul gets on the front foot and knocks it down to long on for a single.
Shortish length on the pads, Chanderpaul tucks it 'round the corner.
A fraction shorter and around off, Kraigg rocks back and cuts it to deep point for one more.
Floated up on the pads, Chanderpaul nudges it toward mid-wicket and turns the strike over.
Shorter and around off, slapped away in front of point for a single.

A chance goes begging! Brandon Mavuta drags it down around off and Kraigg Brathwaite steps out looking for the heave across the line and misses it completely. The keeper, Tafadzwa Tsiga takes a bit of time to collect the ball cleanly and Kraigg manages to get back inside the crease.
This is pitched up well outside the off stump and Chanderpaul just leaves it alone.
On a hard length and a bit closer to the off pole, Chanderpaul punches it out on the off side.
Back of a length outside off, Chanderpaul goes on the back foot and punches it straight to cover-point.
Full and wide again, well inside the tramline this time around and Chanderpaul just lets it through to the keeper. Zimbabwe are probably just looking to curtail the flow of runs here.
WIDE! Looks to bowl it full and wide outside off again but this time it's just a bit too wide. The umpire has had enough and exercises his arms.
Full and wide again, just shaping away a touch from the left-hander. Too wide though for inviting the drive from Chanderpaul.
Starts off with a full and wide one, hugging the tramline outside off. Chanderpaul leaves it alone.
Brad Evans (18-3-44-0) comes into the attack for the first time this morning.
Tossed up full and on off, Kraigg Brathwaite pushes it gently back toward the bowler.
Gives it a bit of loop and bowls it on off stump, Kraigg blocks it out.
This is full and on the stumps, Kraigg Brathwaite nudges it to mid-wicket.
Flatter one around off, Chanderpaul stays back and plays it late toward short third man for a single.
Missed opportunity! This is a juicy full toss around off stump, Tagenarine Chanderpaul only manages to drive it to the right of the bowler and Mavuta manages to make the stop.
Nicely looped up around off, Chanderpaul gets on the front foot and punches it straight back at the bowler.
Fullish length, angling into middle, Kraigg Brathwaite flicks it to mid-wicket.

Risky single and the direct hit is found! Tagenarine Chanderpaul pushes the fuller delivery gently toward mid off and sets off for the quick single. The fielder there attacks the ball and under-arms it onto the stumps at the bowler's end. Chanderpaul though puts in the dive and the replays show that he made it in time. The third umpire gives the green signal.
This is a bit shorter and outside off, Kraigg stays back and taps it in front of point for a single.
FOUR! This is fuller and outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite comes forward and flat-bats it straight down the ground, to the left of the man at long on and for a boundary as well.
On a length again and on off, Kraigg looks to thrash the straight drive but mistimes it badly.
Good length around off stump, Kraigg Brathwaite pushes it gently to the left of the bowler.
Short and outside off, Tagenarine Chanderpaul gets back and plays late. He places it behind backward point and collects two runs.
Goes on the back foot and punches it down to long off for a run.
Full around off, pushed back to the bowler.

FOUR! 150 for Kraigg Brathwaite, his third such score in Tests! Flighted and full, around off, Kraigg Brathwaite slogs it over mid-wicket and finds the gap for a boundary. Out of the 49 runs scored by West Indies this morning, 38 has come from Kraigg's bat. Intent.
Loopy and full, close to off and spinning away, Brathwaite draws forward and defends it from the outside part of his bat.
Brandon gives it an extra loop but fails to land it. Chanderpaul eases the full toss down to long on for a run.
First bowling change of the day as Brandon Mavuta (19-2-53-0) comes on to bowl.
Fuller and on off, Tagenarine eases it with gentle hands, in front of mid off, and steals a quick run.
Fuller and around off, Brathwaite moves across the stumps and nudges it through wide mid on for a run.
Gets on the front foot to a full ball and pushes it back to the bowler.
Back of a length, around off, Chanderpaul whacks it to cover-point where the fielder dives across to his right and parries it behind the point fielder. They take a run.
Length around off, Chanderpaul shuffles across the stumps and helps it to mid-wicket.
On a length and outside off, angling away, Tagenarine Chanderpaul shoulders arms.
Back of a length, around middle and off, Chanderpaul drops it with soft hands to mid-wicket and pinches another quick run.

A direct hit at the bowler's end but the Zimbabwean players are not showing much excitement. Full and around off, Kraigg drives it to mid off and scampers to the other end. The replays show that the West Indian skipper is safely in. The third umpire flashes the green light.
Is that a run-out? The Zimbabwean players don't seem too excited about it but the umpires have gone upstairs.
Short in length and wide outside off, Brathwaite goes for the square cut but chops it down in front of point.
On a length and outside off, Kraigg gets forward and drives it to extra cover.
Good comeback from the bowler. Richard Ngarava pulls his length back a bit and serves it around off. The angle takes it away from the batter who attempts to cut it late but misses.
FOUR! Kraigg continues to attack the left-arm seamer. Full and outside off, Brathwaite fetches it from out there and whips it wide of mid on for a boundary.
A touch short and on off, it's defended off the back foot.
Close to off, on a length and angling away, Tagenarine pushes it from the crease, without much intent.
Angling away from the batter, on a length, Chanderpaul eases himself on the back foot and taps it down to cover-point.
Lands it on a length and outside off, Tagenarine plays it down to backward point.
Does this time. Slower one, on a shortish length and wide outside off, Brathwaite tries to heave across the line but misses. It dies down in front of the keeper who fumbles and they collect a bye.
Short in length and way wide outside off, Kraigg is not ready to chase it away from his body.
Goes full again, outside off, Brathwaite drives and finds the gap at covers for a single.
Fuller delivery, outside off, Kraigg drives square of the wicket on the off side but straight to the fielder.
Fuller and straighter, Chanderpaul plays late and clips it through mid-wicket for three runs.
Harmless delivery. On a length and wide outside off, an easy leave for the batter.

Bowls it full and around off, Chanderpaul drives it down to mid off and sets off for a run. He, then, realizes that he has timed it too well and it has gone quickly to the fielder. Immediately declines the run and sends his partner back.
Serves it on a length and outside off, Chanderpaul gets close to the line of the delivery and then makes a leave.
In the region outside off, on a good length, Kraigg has nothing to do with it. 8 from the over, another good one for West Indies.
Width there outside off, Brathwaite reaches out to cut but it takes the bottom edge and rolls to point.
Play and a miss! This one is served on a good length outside off, holding its line, Kraigg throws his bat at it but fails to connect.

FOUR! Misfield and it's another boundary for West Indies this morning. Full in length and wide outside off, Brathwaite drives it crisply towards extra cover where the fielder dives over the ball and allows it through. 250 comes up for the visiting team.
On a good length, wide outside off, Kraigg leaves it alone.
FOUR! Lovely wristwork from the West Indian skipper. Full in length and around off, Kraigg Brathwaite brings his bottom hand into play and places his flick shot wide of mid on for a boundary.
In the channel outside off, on a good length, Brathwaite forces it through the line and finds the gap at covers. There is a sweeper in the deep and hence only a run. 5 from this over!
FOUR! Bang! Kraigg Brathwaite is batting with better intent this morning. Length delivery around off, there is room to swing his bat and Brathwaite powers it past mid on for a boundary.
Too full and around off, Brathwaite leans across and flicks but fails to find the gap at mid-wicket.
Angling across the off stump, Brathwaite plays late and wristily but still finds the fielder at point.
Slightly short and on off, Kraigg cuts off the back foot but finds the fielder at backward point.
Slants across a length ball, close to off, Kraigg wrists it across the line but towards mid on.
Just behind the good length, around off, Chanderpaul sticks back to punch but his bottom hand comes off the handle and he ends up pushing it loosely to mid off.
On the pads, it's worked to the left of the mid-wicket fielder for a single. The fielder there dives to stop the ball but fumbles and they pinch the second run.
On a length around off, Chanderpaul punches off the back foot but straight to mid off.
Around leg, on a length, Tagenarine helps it away to mid-wicket.
Back of a length, on off, Chanderpaul pushes it off the back foot to covers.
Lands it full around leg, angling away, Chanderpaul plays late and pushes it from the crease to the off side.
Shortish and close to off, Brathwaite goes back and punches it to covers. An eventful over for West Indies, 12 runs from it.
Serves it full and wide outside off, inviting another drive, Kraigg unfurls it but finds the fielder at mid off.

FOUR! Three in a row from the bat of Kraigg. Back of a length, around off, Brathwaite goes on his toes and punches it sweetly down the ground. The mid-off fielder gives the chase but the outfield is quite quick this morning and the ball reaches the fence.
FOUR! Shot of great timing and placement! This one is on a good length, outside off, Brathwaite waits on it and crunches it through cover-point.
FOUR! Mistimed but a boundary! Fuller in length around off, angling away again, Brathwaite drags his attempted drive off the inner edge and it races past mid on for a boundary.
Full and outside off, angling away, Brathwaite pushes it off the front foot to mid off.
Angling away from the batter, around off, Chanderpaul pushes inside the line and misses.
Shortish and on off, too close to the batter, Chanderpaul attempts to punch but mistimes it towards mid off.
Fullish and outside off, Tagenarine drives it through the line but finds the cover fielder.
Goes fuller and serves it around middle and off, Chanderpaul pushes it defensively to mid off.
Brilliant delivery. Some visible swing there. Back of a length, around off and shaping away, Chanderpaul tries to play inside the line and misses.
Fuller in length around off, Kraigg drives it straight back and it collides with the stumps at the other end. The ball deflects wide of mid off and they cross for a run.
Victor Nyauchi (21-5-53-0) to bowl from the other end.
Wrong line. Full and sliding down the leg side, Chanderpaul works it off his legs through square leg. Two runs taken.
Lands it on a length and close to off, this time Chanderpaul stays on the back foot in defense.
Pitches it up and outside off, Chanderpaul pushes it to covers.
Sticking to a good line and length but there is no lateral movement with the new ball. Fullish on off, defended.
Another full ball, around off and angling in, Chanderpaul covers the line and dead-bats it on the surface.
Starts with a full ball around off, Tagenarine Chanderpaul is ready to block it off the front foot.

We are ready for the start of Day 3! The umpires and the Zimbabwean players are out in the middle. The overnight batters for West Indies, Kraigg Brathwaite and Tagenarine Chanderpaul too make their way out to the middle. It will be Richard Ngarava to start proceedings with the ball on a brand new and sunny day. Let's go...

Day 1 saw the play halted for more than an entire session after the rain gods showed up and due to heavy rains on Saturday night, we didn't have play for the majority of Day 2. But as the day progressed, the sun came out and conditions looked the brightest during the final session. With 38 overs to be bowled, the Zimbabwean bowlers failed to create any wicket-taking opportunities and the Windies' openers found it pretty easy to score runs at will. There are still three days remaining in the game and it will be up to how the visiting team approaches things early on Day 3 for us to get an idea of which direction this match is headed. Will West Indies come out all guns blazing and look to score quick runs? Or will the steady approach continue? We shall find out soon.

Hello and a warm welcome to Day 3 of the first Test match between Zimbabwe and West Indies at the Queens Sports Club in Bulawayo. After two days of play we have had only 89 overs bowled and the visiting side is well on top with the score being 221/0 and both openers, Kraigg Brathwaite and Tagenarine Chanderpaul have scored centuries as well. There wasn't any rain on Day 2 but the outfield was soaking wet and hence, we only had one session worth of play. Luckily, the weather forecast for Day 3 and Day 4 looks promising.
... DAY 3, SESSION 1 ...

This Test match has lost plenty of overs already and the onus lies with West Indies to shape it towards a favourable result. The openers have played with caution but we can sense a change in tempo from them on Day 3. For Zimbabwe, although their bowling was disciplined, they never looked threatening to pick wickets. It's a waiting game for them as they are out of ideas. The action on Monday will begin at 1 pm IST (7.30 am GMT), yes there is an early start again and unlike on Day 2, there is no forecast of rain at the beginning of the day's play. Do join us in advance for the build-up. Cheers!

Day 2 comes to a close and it's West Indies in a commanding position. Only 38 overs were possible on Sunday, not because of the rain but due to the wet outfield for the majority of the waiting period. Breaks like these put you off as a batter but Kraigg Brathwaite and Tagenarine Chanderpaul stayed focused and continued with the good work once the day resumed. Both completed a well-compiled century and Tagenarine, in particular, will be thrilled to notch up his maiden Test ton.
Floats it up now around middle, Kraigg Brathwaite solidly blocks it out. That will be Stumps on Day 2!
Slower and shorter around off, Chanderpaul waits on the back foot and eases it through covers for one.
Shortens the length and drifts it onto middle and leg, Chanderpaul nudges it leg side.
Floated up at the stumps, Chanderpaul presses forward and keeps it out.
Nicely flighted on middle and leg, Chanderpaul nudges it out on the leg side.
Tossed up full and on middle, Chanderpaul blocks it out.
Wellington Masakadza to bowl the final over of the day.

A maiden Test hundred for Tagenarine Chanderpaul and the 31st overall for the Chanderpaul family. What a well-composed knock this has been from the young man, reaching his first ton in just his third Test match! He is delighted and soaks in the applause from his teammates. The ball is delivered short and around the body, and Chanderpaul works it away toward square leg for a single.
Good length around leg stump, Chanderpaul shuffles across and looks to tuck but gets a leading edge back towards the bowler. Nerves.
Fuller and around off, Chanderpaul looks to cover drive but mistimes it toward mid off.
A bit short and wide, Chanderpaul cuts but straight to the man at point.
Back of a length around off, this is punched away to covers.

FOUR! This is short and outside off, sitting up for the batter. Tagenarine Chanderpaul gets across and muscles it away in front of mid-wicket for a boundary. Chanderpaul is one run away now from his maiden Test century.

Banged in short over leg stump, Chanderpaul gets inside the line and pulls it down to fine leg for a single. This is now the highest first-wicket partnership for West Indies against Zimbabwe in Test cricket, beating the previous best of 214 runs between Chris Gayle and Daren Ganga.
Good length around off, Chanderpaul looks to cut but the ball shoots up a bit extra and hits the higher part of the bat.
Goes full and straight now, Chanderpaul eases it to short mid on.
Good length around middle and off, Chanderpaul blocks it with a straight bat.
Around the top of off, Chanderpaul punches it on the up but straight to the man at covers.
Good length, angling into middle, Chanderpaul keeps it out.
NO BALL! Richard Ngarava puts in a bit more effort and bowls it short at the body. Chanderpaul fails to pull it away and a no ball is called for overstepping.
Shortish length, around off and just angling in a bit, Brathwaite blocks it onto the off side.
This is full and angling into leg stump, Kraigg Brathwaite flicks it to mid-wicket.
Good length around middle and leg, Brathwaite blocks it out from his crease.
FOUR! A fraction short and outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite waits for it and uses the pace of the ball to just guide it wide of the gully region for a boundary.
Comes from around the wicket to the left-hander and digs in a short ball over off stump. Tagenarine Chanderpaul pulls it along the ground to deep square leg for a run.
Bowled from wide of the crease and angling onto the pads, Kraigg Brathwaite works it away to deep backward square leg for a single.
On a good length and angling in from around off, Chanderpaul gets across and makes a solid block.
Back of a length around off, Brathwaite dabs it onto the off side and scampers through for a run. Excellent running.
FOUR! Lovely timing! Length ball around off stump, Kraigg Brathwaite makes a firm push off the front foot and the ball just runs down to the long off fence for a boundary.
Pitched up on leg stump and swinging back into the pads a bit. Kraigg Brathwaite flicks it straight to backward square leg.
Good length around middle, Brathwaite keeps it out.
Back-of-a-length delivery close to the off stump. Kraigg Brathwaite looks to cut off the back foot but mistimes it off the inner half and back onto the deck.
Richard Ngarava to speed in from the other end. 13 overs from him so far, he has bowled the least overs out of all the seamers used by Zimbabwe.
Fuller and angling across off stump, Chanderpaul solidly keeps it out.
Keeps it short and bowls it on the body, Kraigg Brathwaite tucks it toward square leg for one more.
Short of a length around off, Chanderpaul goes on the back foot and punches it straight back. Richard Ngarava, at mid off, dives to his left and keeps it down to a single.
This is full and around off stump, Chanderpaul goes back and across to defend.

Back of a length around off, Kraigg Brathwaite stands tall and firmly pushes it through covers. The fielders chase and manage to pull it back in. They get three and the 200-run stand is up between the Windies' openers.
Starts off with a length ball on the fifth stump line. Kraigg Brathwaite lets it through to the keeper.

Zimbabwe have opted for the second new ball now. Another 6 overs left in the day's play. Can Zimbabwe get a breakthrough? Victor Nyauchi to make the first use of the new nut. Two slips and a gully in place.
This is around middle, Chanderpaul blocks it out.
A stifled appeal for lbw but it is turned down. Shorter again on leg stump and turning in. Chanderpaul goes back and across to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Slower through the air and a bit shorter on the pads, Chanderpaul keeps it down in front of square leg.
Nicely flighted on middle, Tagenarine Chanderpaul keeps it out.
Floated up, full and outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite strokes it gently towards covers and gets across for a quick single.
A full toss on leg stump, this is flicked away to deepish mid-wicket for an easy single.
Drifted onto leg stump, looking to turn it away. Kraigg Brathwaite stays watchful and blocks it out.
Flighted delivery on middle and leg, Kraigg Brathwaite blocks it off the front foot.
Tossed up, very full and on middle, Brathwaite keeps it out.
This is on the pads, Kraigg Brathwaite flicks it straight to mid-wicket.
Flatter one around off, eased away towards covers.

There it is, Kraigg Brathwaite brings up his 12th Test hundred and his first ever in Zimbabwe. Yet another classy inning from the Windies skipper. Coming to the delivery, the ball is delivered short and around off, Brathwaite stays back and dabs it past first slip for a couple of runs.
Shorter and around off, cut away off the back foot in front of cover-point for a couple of runs. Tagenarine Chanderpaul moves into the 90s as well.
Lucky! A full toss around off, Kraigg Brathwaite hits it hard but to the left of mid-wicket where Chamu Chibhabha makes a good half stop. A single is taken. Brathwaite moves to 99 now.
Floated up full and on the pads, Tagenarine Chanderpaul works it away in front of square leg and picks up a single.
Quicker and shorter on off stump, Kraigg Brathwaite backs away and cuts it well in front of the cover region for three runs.
Tossed up around the pads, Kraigg Brathwaite nudges it onto the leg side.
Around middle, this is pushed away to mid on.
The second new ball is now available. Will Craig Ervine take it right away? No, it will be Brandon Mavuta to continue bowling with the old ball.

SIX! High and handsome! Enough of blocking, says the son of Shivnarine Chanderpaul. Wellington Masakadza floats it up around off, on a fuller length, Tagenarine Chanderpaul wears his skates and launches it over long off for a maximum.
Slower through the air, full and around off, turning in, Chanderpaul draws forward in defense.
Going down the leg side, it's nudged towards fine leg for one.
Fuller and on off, skidding in, Kraigg defends it back from the inner half of his bat.
Fuller and drifting around middle, Brathwaite flicks it to short mid-wicket.
Short and on off, Kraigg gets back inside the crease to cut but finds the fielder at point.
A low full toss around leg, Chanderpaul tries to flick but doesn't close the face of his bat in time. Ends up mistiming it to silly mid on.
Leans forward to meet the full ball outside off and blocks it to covers.
Very full and on off, Chanderpaul jams it out to the off side.
Slow spin away from the batter, Kraigg gets forward and pushes it with an angled bat to backward point. Chanderpaul calls his partner through for a quick run.
Tossed up around off, defended off the front foot to silly point.
Fuller and on middle, it's flicked to deepish mid-wicket for one.
Deft. Outside off, Kraigg plays late and places it wide of backward point for a couple of runs.
A touch short and on off, Tagenarine goes back and helps it with the spin. The ball rolls in front of square on the leg side and they cross.
That is defended solidly off the front foot.
Flighted and full, around off, defended off the front foot.
Short and on off, cut to point where the fielder dives and makes a good half stop.
Floated and full around off, Brathwaite leans and defends it down.
Edgy again. Fuller on off, turning in, Chanderpaul goes hard at it and flicks it off the inner edge to short mid-wicket.
Edgy! Slower through the air, full around off and spinning in, Chanderpaul gets forward and defends it off the inner half. It drops in front of short leg.
Short and on off, turning away, Brathwaite gets back and cuts it to point for a brisk single.
Flatter on off, that is defended solidly off the front foot.
Fullish and on off, Kraigg leans forward and defends.
FOUR! Clean hit! This is now Brathwaite's highest Test score against Zimbabwe in Zimbabwe. Loopy and full around off, Kraigg dances down the track and lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
Floats it up around off, Chanderpaul dances down the track and jams it down on the surface.
Full and outside off, driven to covers.
Lands it full and around off, another forward defense by Tagenarine.
Fuller and on middle, defended to the leg side.
Nicely tossed up, full around off and spinning in, Chanderpaul defends it carefully.
Tossed up around off, defended back.
Slower through the air, full and on off, Kraigg presses forward and defends it safely.
Quicker through the air, short and on off, Brathwaite goes back and forces it to mid on.
Floated and full, around leg, it's worked in front of square leg for a run.
Just a bit short and on off, Brathwaite moves inside the crease and steers it through cover-point for one.
Sliding down the leg side, Kraigg helps it off his pads to backward square leg.
Tossed up around off, Brathwaite defends it off the front foot.
Brandon Mavuta (14-2-35-0) to bowl from the opposite end now.
Goes on the back foot and punches it to covers.
Flighted on off, the batter has just watchfully blocked this out.
Loopy on off, spinning in, Chanderpaul gets opened up in his stance as he defends it to the off side.
Fullish and on off, defended to covers.
Beaten! Excellent delivery. Full and flighted outside off, Chanderpaul lunges to defend with the spin but this one goes straight on to beat the outside edge.
Floated and full, around off, Chanderpaul defends it back.
Serves it on a driving length outside off, Chanderpaul watches the line closely and doesn't commit himself to any shot.
On a good length around off, shaping in, Tagenarine defends off the back foot.
Shortish and on off, Chanderpaul stays back and blocks it to mid on.
Full and on off, angling in from wide of the crease, Chanderpaul gets behind the line and defends.
In the channel outside off, on a good length, it's left alone by the southpaw.
Angles in a length ball, around off, Chanderpaul goes on the back foot and pushes it to the bowler.
Extra loop on this delivery as it drifts around middle, very full in length, Kraigg flicks again but finds mid-wicket this time.
Fires it full and around leg, Brathwaite works it in the gap at mid-wicket for two runs.
Flatter and outside off, Brathwaite taps it down to covers and looks for a run. He is sent back.
Quicker and fuller, around leg, Kraigg defends it to mid-wicket.
Short and around off, Brathwaite gets back and plays it down to covers.
Loopy and full, around off, Kraigg defends it off the front foot.

Drinks break. After a long delay, we finally got some action here in Bulawayo but in terms of the progression of this match, West Indies have kept things in their favour firmly. Both Tagenarine Chanderpaul and Kraigg Brathwaite have looked untroubled and are dealing with everything easily. Zimbabwe are lacking intensity and class with the ball. Can they succeed in taking any wicket before the Stumps? Another 18 overs left in the day's play. Wellington Masakadza to bowl after the break.
Lands it on a length and outside off, staying low, Kraigg pushes it towards cover-point for one.
Short and drifting down the leg side, the batter fails to flick. The keeper dives across to his right but is unable to stop the ball. They cross for a bye.
Goes full again, around off and angling in, Chanderpaul is strong in his defense once more.
Around off, on a length and angling in, Chanderpaul goes on the back foot and defends it to the off side.
In the zone outside off, it's left alone with ease.
Pitches it up and outside off, drawing the batter forward, Chanderpaul defends it to short cover.
Nagging length around leg stump and turning away, Kraigg Brathwaite rocks back and looks to flick but gets himself into an awkward position. Brathwaite misses and gets hit on the pads.
Flatter again and around off, Brathwaite pushes it out.
Flatter and around the pads, Kraigg Brathwaite goes back and dabs it down toward leg slip.
A loopy full toss now on leg stump, Chanderpaul gets foward and works it away to wide long on for a single.
Flighted, full and on middle, Chanderpaul pushes it back to the bowler.
Floated up full and around middle, Chanderpaul pushes it to silly mid on.
Short of a length and outside off, Chanderpaul latches onto it in a flash and cuts it away in between point and cover. The ball plugs in the outfield and they get back for three.
Back of a length outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite opens the face of the blade and eases it through the point region for one.
A hint of reverse there as this full delivery tails back into the middle stump. Kraigg Brathwaite blocks it out.
A bumper now, over leg stump and angling further down leg. Kraigg Brathwaite ducks under it.
Short and wide, tapped away in front of the man at point for a couple of runs.

Hello and welcome to Day 2 of the first Test match between Zimbabwe and West Indies at the Queens Sports Club in Bulawayo.
