This is tossed up, full and on middle and leg, Kraigg Brathwaite works it away through mid-wicket for a single and Wellington Masakadza concedes his first run after the Lunch break.
Comes from around the wicket to the left-hander and tries to angle in a fuller delivery into the off pole. Chanderpaul pushes it out towards covers.
This is full and on the pads, Kraigg Brathwaite flicks it away in front of mid-wicket. Richard Ngarava, from mid on, gives chase and manages to keep it in. The batters pick up an easy three.
Pitched up outside off, Kraigg gets well forward this time and punches the drive to extra cover.
Beaten! Perfect length, angling it in from around off, Kraigg Brathwaite looks to present a dead bat at it but the ball holds its line and zips past the outside edge.
On a good length and outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite is a bit tentative to go after it and ends up tapping it towards cover-point.
Starts off with a shortish delivery angling on the body, Kraigg Brathwaite moves across the off stump and shoulders arms.
Victor Nyauchi (9-4-12-0) comes back into the attack for the first time in this session.
Flatter one on the stumps, this is pushed away to mid on.
This is short again and around middle, Chanderpaul goes back and across before working it on the leg side.
Flighted, around off stump and kept out by Chanderpaul.
This is dragged down around middle, Chanderpaul shuffles and tries to pull it hard but mistimes it toward square leg.
Shortens the length and bowls it on off stump, Chanderpaul looks to get on the back foot and pull but fails to do so.
Gives it a bit of loop and bowls it around middle, Chanderpaul defends it off the front foot.
Good length around the top of off, Kraigg Brathwaite tucks it to mid-wicket.
Short again and directed at the body, Chanderpaul is able to pull it down to deep backward square leg for a single.
A bumper now from Brad Evans. This is bowled over middle and angled in, Tagenarine Chanderpaul ducks under it well.
A fraction shorter and around the hips, Chanderpaul nudges it in front of mid-wicket.
Fullish length around off, Chanderpaul tries to get on the front foot and pushes it toward mid off this time.
This is pitched up at the stumps, and Chanderpaul drives it straight to mid on.
This is angled into middle and leg, a bit flatter and Kraigg Brathwaite tucks it leg side. Wellington Masakadza just keeps on bowling maidens.
Floated up around off, Kraigg Brathwaite blocks it off the front foot.

Half a chance there! Nicely drifted onto middle and leg, Kraigg Brathwaite flicks it straight to short leg on the bounce and is out of his crease. Just as the fielder gathers the ball, Kraigg scampers back.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Kraigg Brathwaite backs away a bit and pushes it to mid on.
Flighted delivery, full and around the pads, Kraigg works it to mid-wicket.
Nicely tossed up on off stump, Kraigg Brathwaite presses forward and pushes it toward mid off.
Goes a bit wider of the crease and angles in a length ball into the off pole. Chanderpaul stays back and keeps it down on the off side.
This is pitched up on off stump, Kraigg Brathwaite pushes it to the left of mid off and sets off for the single. Good running.
Back of a length and around off, Kraigg Brathwaite plays it toward mid on.
This is a bit short and at the pads, Chanderpaul shuffles and tucks it away through square leg for one.
This is full and on off stump, Chanderpaul just gets squared up a touch and edges it behind point.
Good length, drifted onto the pads, Kraigg Brathwaite works it to deep backward square leg for a run.
On a shorter length and on the stumps, Chanderpaul keeps it out on the leg side. Yet another maiden over from Wellington Masakadza.
Wellington Masakadza fires this one a bit and bowls it fuller on off stump, Chanderpaul does well to get some bat on it.
A bit slower and on a length on off stump, Chanderpaul watchfully keeps it out.
Flatter delivery around middle, Chanderpaul rocks back and pulls it hard but straight to the man at mid-wicket.
On a good length and around middle, Chanderpaul nudges it onto the leg side.
Flighted on a nagging length and outside off, Chanderpaul goes on the back foot and edges it down toward the gully region.
Back of a length and around off, Kraigg keeps it down on the off side using soft hands.

Good work in the deep by Tanunurwa Makoni. This is shorter and down leg, Kraigg Brathwaite works it off his hips behind square on the leg side. Makoni runs to his right from deep backward square leg and puts in the dive to save a couple of runs.
On a hard length and over the off stump, Kraigg Brathwaite stays back and nudges it on the leg side. The umpire has a word with Brad Evans about running onto the danger area.
Here comes the release! This is full and on the pads, Chanderpaul works it toward deep backward square leg for a single.
Short of a length around off, Chanderpaul comes forward and looks to force it through extra cover but fails to do so. The pressure of the dot balls keeps on building on the batters.
This is bowled back of a length and around off stump, Tagenarine Chanderpaul gets behind the line and blocks it out.
Holds it back a touch and bowls it on off stump, Kraigg Brathwaite watchfully keeps it out. Another maiden!
Just short! This is tossed up around middle and Kraigg Brathwaite has a bit of an agricultural slog at it and ends up mistiming it in front of the man at mid-wicket.
This is drifted onto middle, full and Kraigg keeps it out.
This is full and on middle, Kraigg Brathwaite eases it back to the bowler.
Drifted onto the leg stump, Kraigg Brathwaite blocks it off the front foot.
This is on a length and on off stump, Kraigg Brathwaite stays back and works it to mid-wicket.
Uses the angle of the bowler and works a length ball in front of square on the leg side. Finds mid-wicket. Two maidens in a row.
Back of a length, on middle and leg, Chanderpaul turns it on the leg side but finds square leg.
Fuller and on off, it's stroked off the front foot to cover-point.
Lands it on a good length, around off and angling in, Chanderpaul pushes it off the back foot to covers.
Spears it in, very full and on middle, Chanderpaul pushes it down to mid on.
Fuller and on off, angling in, Chanderpaul draws forward and defends it with an angled bat.
Wellington keeps it nice and tight around off, fuller in length, Kraigg Brathwaite is comfortable in defending off the front foot.
Fuller and on middle, drifting in, Brathwaite is forward as he blocks it safely.
Quicker and shorter outside off, Brathwaite covers the stumps and leaves it alone.
Loopy and full, on off, Kraigg presses forward in defense.
Short again, around off and skidding in, Brathwaite goes on the back foot and taps it down to the right of the point fielder.
Flatter and fuller on off, Kraigg stays back and eases it to point.
Wellington Masakadza (3-0-9-0) to operate from the opoosite end.
Shortish on off, Chanderpaul goes on the back foot and helps it towards mid-wicket.
Full in length and on off, driven off the front foot to covers.
Oh dear, this one stays very low. On a length and just outside off, Chanderpaul tries to push at it but it goes under the bat and towards the keeper.
FOUR! In full control of the shot this time! Back of a length, around off, Tagenarine Chanderpaul camps back and crunches it through cover-point for a cracking boundary.

FOUR! There was a half chance. Brad digs it in short around off and it shoots onto the batter. Tagenarine Chanderpaul gets hurried up into his pull shot and the ball flies behind off his gloves. Tafadzwa Tsiga, the keeper, jumps but it evades his gloves and races behind for a boundary.
Begins the session with a gentle loosener. Fuller and wider outside off, Tagenarine Chanderpaul has nothing to do with it.

We are back for the post-Lunch session on Day 1! The umpires are back out in the middle and so are the players of Zimbabwe. Kraigg Brathwaite and Tagenarine Chanderpaul are all set to resume their stay on the crease. It will be Brad Evans to start proceedings with the ball here.
... DAY 1, SESSION 2 ...

Right then, the sun is just starting to shine a bit brighter in Bulawayo and the overcast conditions have subsided. With the early platform laid down, West Indies will look to score a bit more freely in the afternoon session and get a good grasp on the game. Zimbabwe will hope to pick up a few wickets and there is a chance of some rain as well. Hopefully, it doesn't affect the game much and we can get a full day of action squeezed in. Join us for the post-Lunch session at 4.10 pm IST (10.40 am GMT).

Zimbabwe started the first session positively as both the new-ball bowlers, Richard Ngarava and Victor Nyauchi kept the lines tight and didn't let the West Indies openers get away. They however failed to create many (any) wicket-taking opportunities and with not much on offer from the surface, the pacers were left a bit frustrated. Both Richard and Nyauchi bowled well in their second spells but once again failed to get the breakthrough. They will be hoping that the spinners play a role in the following session and get the breakthrough they need.

A fairly evenly contested first session of Test cricket comes to an end but it will be the visiting side, West Indies who will be the happier of the two teams heading into the Lunch interval. The conditions were overcast but the pitch didn't have much in it for the seamers and both the Windies openers, Kraigg Brathwaite and Tagenarine Chanderpaul just kept their patience levels up and ensured that they went into the break with all 10 wickets still intact. Kraigg did play a few shots here and there but did look a little unsure at times as well.
Short in length and on off, Tagenarine Chanderpaul rocks back and punches it to mid off for a quick run. Time for Lunch on Day 1.
Fuller and on off, it's driven down to mid on.
Fuller and on off, turning in, Chanderpaul lunges to defend it with firm hands and gets an inside edge. It goes wide of short leg.
Pulls his length back and serves it around off, Chanderpaul goes back and pushes it to mid on.
Floated and full, around off, Chanderpaul defends it off the front foot.
Starts with a short ball, on off, Kraigg moves back and eases it towards the cover region for a single.
With just a few minutes left for the Lunch break, Brandon Mavuta comes in to roll his arm.
Loopy and full around off, once again Tagenarine prods forward in defense.
Fullish and on off, Chanderpaul draws forward and meets it with a straight defensive bat.
Short around off, turning in, Chanderpaul goes back and punches it to mid on.
A shade short and around off, Brathwaite goes on the back foot and plays it late. He places it shot to the left of backward point and rotates the strike.
Slower through the air, full and on off, again Kraigg defends it back off the front foot.
Fuller and on off, defended back to the bowler.
Close to off, on a good length and angling in, Tagenarine sticks back and defends it late to the off side.
Fuller and on off, defended solidly.
Angling in around middle and off, on a length, Chanderpaul plays late and pushes it away from the inner half of his bat to mid on.
On a good length around off, angling in, Tagenarine defends it from the back foot to the off side.
Shortish and on off, punched through the line on the off side but not in the gap.
Excellent yorker, landing in the blockhole, Chanderpaul does well to dig it out safely.
Quicker one, short and outside off, Brathwaite drags his pull shot towards mid on.
Turning into the batter from around middle, Chanderpaul helps it past short leg and picks up a single.
Skidding down the leg side, Kraigg works it off his pads and nudges it behind square leg. Takes a single. 50 up for West Indies!
Aggression shown by Chanderpaul. He steps down the track to a full ball and heaves it across the line. It's aerial but in the gap at mid-wicket for three runs.
Tossed up outside off, turning in with some extra bounce, Chanderpaul plays very late and defends it on the off side.
Flatter through the air, a touch short and on off, Kraigg gets back and forces it to mid on for a run.
Back of a length, on top of off, Tagenarine Chanderpaul goes on the back foot and punches it to mid off.
On a good length and just outside off, Chanderpaul keeps his bat inside the line and withdraws it late.
Pitches it up and on off, Chanderpaul has his bat down in time as he pushes it defensively to covers.
A harmless delivery, on a length and outside off, an easy leave for the batter.
In the channel outside off, on a length and holding its line, Chanderpaul covers his stumps and shoulders arms.
Angles in a length ball around off, Chanderpaul reaches out and pushes it towards cover-point.
Slower through the air, full and landing on middle, Kraigg flicks it gently to mid-wicket.
Fuller and on middle, defended back easily.
Slightly short and on middle, skidding down, Kraigg moves back and wrists it down to fine leg for a couple of runs.
Loopy around middle, drifting in, Kraigg lunges and blocks it down.
A bit short and on off, Brathwaite goes on the back foot and punches it to covers.
Starts with a flighted delivery, full and on off, Kraigg is on the front foot as he defends it back.
Time for some spin as Wellington Masakadza is brought into the attack.
Serves it on a length around off, Tagenarine Chanderpaul defends it back to complete the over.
Very full and on off, Chanderpaul drives it back to the bowler who picks it up and has a shy at the striker's end. Signs of aggression or frustration, not sure.
Fuller in length and outside off, Brathwaite drives it through the gap at covers. Three fielders chase, one of them gets to the ball first and stops it from going to the fence. Three runs taken.
Lands it on a good length, around off, Kraigg pushes it from the outer half his blade to cover-point.
Bowls it full and around off, Brathwaite defends it back to the bowler.
A gentle loosener, short and around leg, Chanderpaul pulls it down to deep square leg for a single.
Change in bowling. Victor Nyauchi returns for his second spell. None for 8 in his 6 overs so far.
This is banged in short and over middle, Kraigg Brathwaite hops back and manages to keep the ball down.
On a good length and outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite doesn't play at it.
This is pitched up around off, Kraigg Brathwaite strokes it toward cover.

A huge appeal for caught behind but it is turned down. Richard Ngarava bowls it on a hard length around off and Kraigg Brathwaite just doesn't pick up the length. Kraigg looks to get forward but decides to go back at the last moment, getting caught on the crease. The ball zips past the blade and there is a sound but the replays show that it might have come off the arm. Just for the record, there is no DRS available.
Pitches it up in that channel around off and Kraigg Brathwaite shoulders arms at it.
Good length outside off and angling away, Kraigg Brathwaite leaves it alone for the keeper to collect.
Shorter and on the body, Chanderpaul tucks it away in front of square leg and picks up a couple of runs.
On a length around off, Chanderpaul presses forward and drives it toward mid off.
Full and angling into the stumps, Chanderpaul pushes it out on the off side.
NO BALL! Another front foot no ball from Brad Evans and he is just over-extending himself a bit here. This is bowled fuller and around off, Chanderpaul pushes it toward mid off.
Back of a length and around off, played off the back foot towards cover-point.

NO BALL! This time the umpire does penalize Brad Evans but for overstepping and the replays show that his front foot was way over the line. The ball is on a good length around off, and Chanderpaul defends it onto the off side.

Keeps it full and angles it into the off stump, Chanderpaul gets forward well and drives it straight to mid off. Brad Evans seems to have gone a bit too wide of the crease and planted his foot beyond the tramline while delivering the ball but he gets away with it.
This is pitched up on the fourth stump line and Tagenarine Chanderpaul shoulders arms at it.
Just a tad fuller and around off, Kraigg Brathwaite leaves it alone.
Lovely delivery! This is delivered on a length around off stump and the ball zips through. Kraigg Brathwaite gets neither forward nor back and has a feel for it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
On a good length and pushed well wide of the off stump. No shot is offered by Kraigg this time.
This is pitched up outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite gets forward and pushes it through the cover region for a couple of runs.
A touch fuller but Richard Ngarava keeps the ball in that corridor around off. Kraigg Brathwaite watchfully lets it through to the keeper.
Nicely bowled! Nagging length, in that channel outside off and angling across. Kraigg Brathwaite leaves it alone.
Around the top of off, Chanderpaul keeps it down on the off side.
Goes fuller now and keeps it around off, Chanderpaul drives on the up but finds the man at covers.
Back of a length around off and angling in, Chanderpaul stays on the back foot and taps it towards covers.
Length ball, angled into middle and leg, Chanderpaul shuffles a bit and works it through mid-wicket for another brace.
A tad short and wide, Chanderpaul cuts it off the back foot and in front of cover-point for a couple of runs.
Back of a length and over middle, Tagenarine Chanderpaul gets behind the line and keeps it down on the deck.
A beauty to end a maiden over. This is a bit fuller and closer to the off pole, Kraigg Brathwaite looks to defend it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
This is very full and wide outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite looks to drive it square but only manages to jam it out on the off side.
Good length, outside off and angling across, Kraigg Brathwaite leaves it alone and the ball dies on its way to the keeper.
And again! Pitches it a bit further up and bowls it on the fifth stump line, Kraigg makes yet another leave.
Good line! This is on a length and around off, angling across the right-hander. Kraigg Brathwaite lets it through to the keeper.
Sort of a floater from Richard Ngarava as he bowls it in the blockhole around off stump. Kraigg Brathwaite digs it out towards extra cover.
This is full and straight, Tagenarine Chanderpaul drills the straight drive back at the bowler and Brad Evans does well to get down low to his left and make the stop.
Back of a length and around middle, Tagenarine Chanderpaul tucks it 'round the corner.
Fullish length, angling in from around off, Chanderpaul tentatively pushes it onto the off side.
A tad short and around the body, Chanderpaul dabs it down in front of mid-wicket.
Good, positive running. Around the top of off, Kraigg just drops it with gentle hands in front of extra cover and scampers through to the other end.
On a hard length around the top of off, Kraigg Brathwaite defends it back onto the deck.

Drinks break. As expected, it's been a slow start to this Test match. West Indies have adopted a cautious approach against the new ball. To be honest, the new nut has not done much and credit to the Zimbabwean seamers for bowling disciplined lines. It's looking like a good batting strip but a few balls have stayed low already. The tourists would have seen that and will aim to bat long and bat big to bat the hosts out of this Test. That said, let's not get ahead of ourselves and see what happens in the next hour.
Nagging length around middle and angling in, Chanderpaul nudges it onto the on-side.
Full again, on middle and leg, Chanderpaul flicks it straight to mid-wicket.
This is pitched up on middle, and Chanderpaul drives it towards mid on.
This is full and in that channel around the off stump, Chanderpaul shoulders arms at it.
Short of a length and on the body, Kraigg Brathwaite hops and tucks it away behind square leg for a single.
On a length well outside off with the natural angle taking it away from the right-hander as well. Kraigg Brathwaite leaves it alone.
Richard Ngarava has a change of ends. None for 12 from his 4 overs so far.
Bowls it a bit wider of the off stump, trying to angle it in, Chanderpaul looks to drive but tries to pull out of the shot late and ends up easing it onto the off side.
Good length around middle, Chanderpaul tucks it away to mid-wicket.
Full and straight, Tagenarine Chanderpaul bunts it back to the bowler who has a shy at the batter's end, just trying to keep Chanderpaul in check.
This is pitched up around middle, Kraigg Brathwaite flicks it away wide of mid on and Richard Ngarava over there makes a good diving effort to his right to keep it down to a single.
Fuller and on the pads, Kraigg Brathwaite clips it to the left of the man at deep backward square leg for a couple of runs. The umpires are also checking for a short run but everything seems fine.
On a length around the off-stump line and just straightening a touch. Kraigg Brathwaite watchfully keeps it out.
Back of a length and on a tight line around off, Chanderpaul looks to punch off the back foot but mistimes it towards cover.
Switches to 'round the wicket now and bowls it in the channel around off. Chanderpaul plays inside the line of the ball.
This is full again and on the pads, Kraigg Brathwaite nudges it toward square leg and gets across for an easy single.
FOUR! Overpitched and punished! This is around middle, Kraigg Brathwaite uses his wrists to pierce the gap around mid-wicket and pick up a boundary.
A touch fuller and angling at the stumps, Kraigg Brathwaite shuffles across and tucks it toward square leg.
This is on a length around the off stump and nipping back in, Kraigg Brathwaite keeps it out off the front foot.
The bowler is not happy with the ball. Perhaps the seam has come out. Victor Nyauchi tosses it to one of the umpires and gets it fixed. The game resumes...
Bowls it on a hard length this time and outside off, Chanderpaul goes back and across before cutting it straight to point.
Fullish length, angling into middle and leg, Chanderpaul firmly defends it to covers.
On a length, trying to swing it away from the middle and leg stump line but Chanderpaul keeps it out.
Keeps it full but strays onto the pads, Kraigg Brathwaite flicks it to fine leg and rotates the strike.
This is full again and at the stumps, Chanderpaul pushes it out in front of cover-point and picks up a single.
Evans comes from around the wicket to the left-hander and angles in a fuller delivery into the off stump. Tagenarine Chanderpaul gets on the front foot and blocks it onto the off side.
Fuller and around middle, angling down, Chanderpaul flicks it down to long leg for a single.
This one is served on a good length, close to off and holding its line, Chanderpaul pushes inside the line and misses.
Pitches it up and around off, Tagenarine plays a handsome drive off the front foot but finds the cover fielder.
Around off, on a good length, Chanderpaul blocks it from the back foot.
Goes fuller and on off, angling in, the batter defends it towards silly mid on.
With a silly mid on in place, Victor runs in from 'round the wicket and bowls it short on off, Chanderpaul goes on the back foot and pushes it to cover-point.
Fuller and on off, rather than getting forward, the West Indian skipper pushes it from the back foot, towards the cover region.
Darts a length ball on off, Brathwaite defends it back from the crease.
That's the line. Full in length and outside off, nipping away a bit, Kraigg initially looks to push inside the line but then pulls his bat back.
Short in length around off, Chanderpaul stands tall to ride the bounce and pulls it towards long leg for a single.
Fuller and on off, a hint of movement in the air, Kraigg clips it to square leg and pinches a single.
Begins with a shortish ball on off, Kraigg Brathwaite stays back and defends it down to the leg side.
The debutant, Brad Evans comes on as first change.
Full and outside off, again staying low, Tagenarine Chanderpaul pushes at it and misses.
Full and outside off, the batter shoulders arms to let that one through.
Angling into the batter from a length around off, Tagenarine Chanderpaul helps it to mid-wicket. There is a fumble but they decide against the single.
Interesting delivery, a touch short outside off but not rising much. Chanderpaul plays inside the line and misses.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and defends it back.
Victor comes from 'round the wicket to the left-hander and angles in a shortish ball on off, Chanderpaul defends it to the off side.
Back of a length, around off, Chanderpaul drops it with gentle hands, in front of square on the off side, and calls his partner through for a quick run.
Very full and on off, once again Chanderpaul is patient enough to block it back to the bowler.
Richard goes nice and full, around off, it's met with a defensive bat of Tagenarine Chanderpaul.
Skiddy delivery, on a length and outside off, Chanderpaul keeps his bat close to his body and allows it through to the keeper.
Fullish and on off, defended to the off side.
FOUR! Waited for 18 balls and opens his account on the 19th ball with a boundary. Short in length, around off, Tagenarine Chanderpaul swivels on the back foot and pulls it through square leg.
Victor is mixing his lengths nicely. Fuller this time, around off, it's defended to covers. First maiden over of the match!
Slightly short and on off, Kraigg goes on the back foot and blocks it back on the surface.
Fuller in length, on middle and leg, Brathwaite shuffles across the stumps a bit and helps it towards square leg. Good pressure sustained by Zimbabwe.
Slightly fuller and attacking the off stump, Kraigg gets behind the line solidly and defends it back.
Probing delivery, on a length outside off and shaping away a hint, Brathwaite pushes inside the line with unsure footwork, only to get beaten.
Back of a length, in the region outside off, Brathwaite covers his stumps and shoulders arms.
Darts it in, very full and on off, Chanderpaul has his bat down in time as he defends it to the off side.
Identical to the last delivery, but the line is a bit far away from the batter outside off. Chanderpaul leaves.
Beauty! Richard Ngarava gets this delivery to angle in around off, Tagenarine Chanderpaul plays the line but the away movement beats his bat.
On middle and leg, defended on the leg side.
Risky run! Very full and on off, Kraigg digs it out towards mid off and takes a brisk single. The fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end, otherwise, it could have been close.
Beaten by the angle! Richard Ngarava puts it on a length around off, Kraigg Brathwaite stays back to have a feel of this delivery and gets beaten.
Short in length and wide outside off, Tagenarine cuts from the back foot but finds point. Stays on zero.
Good shape away from the left-hander, outside off, Chanderpaul drops his bat and lets it through.
The West Indies players are wearing a black armband in this game to pay respect to the former West Indian Test and One-Day cricketer Irvine Shillingford who passed away a few days back.
Fractionally short and on off, Chanderpaul goes on the back foot and defends it down safely.
Just behind the good length, around off and shaping away, once again Tagenarine Chanderpaul stick back to defend but misses.
Slants across a shortish delivery, around off and angling away, Tagenarine Chanderpaul stays back and keeps his bat inside the line of the ball.
Fuller and on middle, Kraigg Brathwaite nudges it towards mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Serves it on a length and outside off, holding its line, Tagenarine feels for it and gets beaten.
Richard perhaps was looking for a yorker but instead he hurls across a full toss on middle, Tagenarine Chanderpaul pushes it back to the bowler. A good opportunity missed to open his account.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and defends it solidly once more.
The length goes a shade fuller, around off, Chanderpaul stands back with an open stance and blocks it to the off side.
Back of a length around off, Tagenarine Chanderpaul is on the back foot in defense.

FIVE RUNS! Length delivery around off, Kraigg taps it down to covers and takes a quick run. Brad Evans doesn't get the radar correct with his throw at the bowler's end and concedes a boundary with no one backing up.
Lands it very full and around off, Brathwaite drives it to the left of the mid off fielder and scampers across to the other end.
Full and angling in around off, it's defended off the front foot to covers.
This one is a bit too wide outside off, an easy leave for the West Indian skipper.
Play and a miss! That's the channel you want to attack Kraigg Brathwaite. Fuller and around off, angling in and then straightening off the seam, Kraigg tries to drive but misses completely.
Goes full and bowls it around off, Kraigg is forward, not entirely though, as pushes it defensively to mid off.
Starts with a delivery on the shorter side, around off, Kraigg goes on the back foot and defends it down.
Victor Nyauchi to share the new ball with Richard Ngarava.
Another excellent delivery, close to off but moving away, Chanderpaul attempts to play inside the line but gets beaten.
Pitches it up and around off, Tagenarine Chanderpaul gets on the front foot and defends it back solidly.
A bit wide outside off this time, Chanderpaul withdraws his bat at the last moment.
Beautiful delivery. The length is full and it's angled around off. Tagenarine Chanderpaul doesn't show much footwork as he attempts to defend but is beaten by the late away movement.
West Indies are away! Back of a length, around middle and leg, Kraigg goes on his toes and taps it down towards backward square leg for one.
Richard begins with a full delivery, in the zone outside off and it goes away from the right-hander with the angle. Kraigg Brathwaite has a good look before making a leave.

Done with the pre-game formalities and we are now all set for the play to begin. The two teams are waiting on the sidelines raring to go but first, both sets of players will take a knee to show their support for the BLM movement. The umpires are out in the middle and so are the players of Zimbabwe. It will be Kraigg Brathwaite to open the batting for West Indies alongside Tagenarine Chanderpaul. Richard Ngarava has the new ball in hand and is raring to go. Let's play...

We are a few minutes away from the start of the Test match. But first, the two sides will line up for their respective national anthems. It will be the West Indies' national anthem first, followed by the national anthem of Zimbabwe.

The Zimbabwean skipper, Craig Ervine says that they would have batted first as well and it is a bit dry which means it will turn later on. Adds that the boys are feeling good and they have had a good week of preparation. Mentions that they have got five debutants for this game and with big names missing out, it is a great opportunity for the young guys to perform. Says that it has been a bit wet over the last few days and will look to pick up early wickets with the new ball.
Kraigg Brathwaite, the captain of West Indies, says that they want to put up a big total on the board. Adds that they had a good preparation and are ready to go.

West Indies come into this Test series with a lot of hope and promise and given the glimpses we saw in their last series against Australia, they would be fairly confident of getting a win here. Skipper Kraigg Brathwaite will be vital for them up top and the promise young Tagenarine Chanderpaul showed last time around will certainly bolster their batting further. The pace department looks pretty sorted with the likes of Kemar Roach and Alzarri Joseph leading the pack and a return to the side for Shannon Gabriel will only help their cause. West Indies have the experience and the team to win the series but Zimbabwe will be looking to conjure up something special in front of their home crowd. Which side will take the bull by its horn and make early inroads? We shall find out soon as the toss and team sheets are not far away. Stay tuned.
